original_test_intent: Run a five-minute InfiniBand write-bandwidth test on every approved port and verify bandwidth, port-error deltas and host/peer health.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Check CRC/error counters, run ib_write_bw for five minutes, recheck counters, and repeat for other ports.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Bandwidth meets the project specification and the system remains workable without new errors.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Retained perftest family but lacked exact endpoint/profile control.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Required peer, topology, package and approval but proposed a duration option incorrectly.
historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED; corrected duration semantics and enforced per-port authoritative counters and full output.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Network owners approve endpoints, IB fabric isolation and profile; orchestration is then automatable.
required_user_inputs: Compatible perftest versions and symmetric options
Five-minute duration syntax for installed version

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: InfiniBand mode, five minutes and every port are retained.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: RoCE or Ethernet is a separately selected project mode and cannot be reported as completion of this InfiniBand case.

original_method: Retain ib_write_bw and before/after counter checks; map each physical IB port rather than grepping an unrelated ethX.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the installed perftest documentation to run symmetric server/client commands with explicit port/path and verified 300-second duration, capturing authoritative IB counters.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Linux RDMA perftest ib_write_bw documentation for the installed release.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original: Makes duration, peer options and per-port mapping executable and auditable.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preserves every-port IB coverage; Ethernet counters are only supplemental when correctly mapped.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Shared-fabric saturation, option mismatch or wrong-port traffic can invalidate or impact production.

safety_boundaries: No unapproved shared-fabric saturation or guessed endpoint.
No insecure credentials or counter/log clearing.
Stop on link flap, wrong-port traffic, error storm or host/peer impact.
expected_evidence: IB counter deltas and link state
no_automatic_retry: A failed port/path remains recorded; no option/path change or second run without approval.
engineer_owned_verdict: Agent compares against supplied targets; network engineer owns the result.
review_improvement: V3.1 preserves V3's corrected technical method and explicitly prevents the project network-mode choice from collapsing InfiniBand, RoCE and Ethernet into one test.
